title: docs(releases): correct the falsified batch-cap claim on the 17.0 release page (#18854)
body:
Fixes #18854

The 17.0 release page (`content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`) told bulk callers the batch cap was "raisable to 1000". That claim was ruled false on 2026-09-07 (director seat, summon #17, decision batch #2, maintainer 「同意」): `batch.maxBatchSize` is embedder policy — `RestServerConfig.batch.maxBatchSize`, 1..1000, default 200 — written only by a host that constructs the server; `os serve` and the dev plugins pass none, so a CLI-started deployment is at 200 and no published surface raises it.

Eight carriers were corrected under that ruling (#15543, #16801, #16940, #17183, #18739, #18740 ×8 sites via PR #18852). This is the ninth and last: the bullet is corrected in the entry itself and carries a dated erratum, in the shape PR #18852 established.

- **Dedicated docs-only PR** per `AGENTS.md`'s Documentation Guardrails row for `content/docs/releases/` (factual error on a releases page → dedicated docs-only PR, never a rider). Opened by the director seat executing decision batch #155 item 1 (maintainer 「同意」 to B on #18854); the dispatched dev correctly declined this site under `os-dev.md:67`, whose alignment is its own card.
- Diff: one file, one bullet (+8/−2). No source, no schema, no export, no test.
- `Clause-②: no` — no contract surface. No changeset (docs-only; `skip-changeset` label applied).
- Claim record on the card: objectstack#18854 comment 5725535123 (`Branch:` this branch, `Clause-②: no` — both carriers agree; `check-clause2-carriers --pair 18907` exit 0 locally).
